business_summary: ACI Worldwide, Inc. develops, markets, installs, and supports software products and services for facilitating electronic payments in the United States and worldwide. It operates through Payment Software, and Billers segments. The company offers ACI Acquiring, a solution to process credit, debit, and prepaid card transactions, deliver digital innovation, fraud prevention, and reduce fees; ACI Issuing, a digital payment issuing solution; and ACI Connetic, a solution that offers payment services for processing, routing, and managing various payment types. It provides ACI real-time payments, a solution that provides connectivity to payment rails; ACI RTGS and cross-border, a payments engine that offers multi-currency, payment and STP processing, and back-office integration interfaces; and ACI digital central infrastructure, a solution that offers real-time payments service. Further, it offers ACI Payments Orchestration Platform, a payments platform that orchestrates and optimizes payments; ACI Fraud Management for merchants, billers, and financial institutions; ACI Fraud Scoring Services with artificial and human insights with data intelligence; and Speedpay, an integrated suite of digital billing, payment, disbursement, and communication services. Additionally, it offers electronic bill presentment and payment services to consumer finance, insurance, healthcare, higher education, utility, government, subscription provider, telecommunications, and mortgage sectors; product installations and configurations, and custom software modifications; and business and technical consultancy, on-site support, product education, and testing services, as well distributes software developed by third parties. It has strategic partnerships with dLocal. The company was formerly known as Transaction Systems Architects, Inc. and changed its name to ACI Worldwide, Inc. in July 2007. The company was founded in 1975 and is headquartered in Elkhorn, Nebraska.
business_summary_ko: ACI Worldwide, Inc.는 미국 및 전 세계에서 전자 결제를 촉진하기 위한 소프트웨어 제품 및 서비스를 개발, 판매, 설치 및 지원합니다. 결제 소프트웨어 및 청구서 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 이 회사는 신용, 직불 및 선불 카드 거래를 처리하고 디지털 혁신을 제공하며 사기 방지 및 수수료 절감을 제공하는 솔루션인 ACI Acquiring을 제공합니다. 디지털 결제 발행 솔루션인 ACI Issuing; 다양한 결제 유형의 처리, 라우팅, 관리를 위한 결제 서비스를 제공하는 솔루션인 ACI Connetic이 있습니다. 결제 레일에 대한 연결을 제공하는 솔루션인 ACI 실시간 결제를 제공합니다. 다중 통화, 결제 및 STP 처리, 백오피스 통합 인터페이스를 제공하는 결제 엔진인 ACI RTGS 및 크로스보더 실시간 결제 서비스를 제공하는 솔루션인 ACI 디지털 중앙 인프라. 또한 결제를 조정하고 최적화하는 결제 플랫폼인 ACI Payments Orchestration Platform을 제공합니다. 가맹점, 청구인 및 금융 기관을 위한 ACI 사기 관리; 데이터 인텔리전스와 인공 및 인간 통찰력을 갖춘 ACI 사기 채점 서비스 Dig의 통합 제품군인 Speedpay
